audience: Indonesian online sellers that book courier pickups with Biteship

useCases.title: Compare courier rates for a route
useCases.text: Find the area ids of the origin and the destination. Get the price and delivery time of each courier service for that route. No order is created.

useCases.title: List the courier services before a booking
useCases.text: List the courier services Biteship can book, with their codes, service types and cash-on-delivery support.

useCases.title: Book a courier pickup after approval
useCases.text: Check the rates of the route first. After the user approves the exact shipment and its cost, create the order. The order uses the monthly quota or the account balance.

useCases.title: Track a parcel and read its order
useCases.text: Read the tracking status and history of a shipment by its tracking id. Read an order by its id to see its status and waybill id.

useCases.title: Cancel an order when the user asks
useCases.text: Cancel a live order by its id, only when the user asks to cancel that order.
